lessons.keep: Make an abstract service concrete through one input, named criteria and an output.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting subjective percentage scores without a clear basis.
lessons.open: Funding, partnerships, quality scores, model improvement, exact animation and audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Show a Tin ad evaluated against three brand rules, then show the exact corrected version.
Use one simple connector diagram for the agent service and follow it with a real approval record.

comparison.story: State mission and funding. → Show the perceived quality problem. → Locate taste in human judgment. → Illustrate measuring and retrieving design judgment. → Describe a model-training role. → Show the intended agent integration. → Recruit people to the mission.
